text:
Maya: quick copy ping — we're iterating on the compact inline error that shows on small cards (mobile/compact desktop). Current message gets clipped and people miss the action. need something shorter + accessible. Jared: can we shorten to: "Couldn’t save. Try again."? removes noun and saves space. Evelyn: +1 on shorter copy. also important: screen readers must announce the error when it appears. use an aria-live region. probably "assertive" for errors, but test with VO. Maya: throwing up a few microcopy options (very compact): A) "Save failed. Retry" B) "Save failed. Try again" C) "Save failed. Check connection" Which reads best and fits two lines? Tom: prefer A — punchy and action-focused. button label should be "Retry" not "Try again". Jared: UI constraint — we only have room for ~32 chars before truncation on the smallest breakpoint. A fits. Also plan to cap to two lines and ellipsize. Evelyn: accessibility notes: - aria-live snippet suggestion: ```html
Save failed. Retry.
``` - If focus moves, ensure focus goes to the Retry button OR provide focusable dismiss. - Color/contrast: error text/icon must meet 4.5:1 on the bg. current orange (#FFB84D) + white fails on small text. consider #D9534F or #E02424. Maya: thanks — will update Figma. quick question on the secondary link: do we want a tiny "Report"/help anchor? worried about visual clutter. Tom: only if we can hide it behind ellipsis on XS. prefer to keep primary action minimal for now. copybot: microcopy tweak — if we ever show more guidance in expanded state: "If this repeats, contact support." keep that out of the compact card. Jared: implementation note: add `data-testid` and an animation-free insertion (no flashing) so SRs consistently pick it up. also add a11y test asserting aria-live text equals copy. Evelyn: verify that when the card appears it doesn't trap focus unless the user tabs to it. avoid unexpected focus jumps. Maya: I'll land the copy as A + button 'Retry', skip the visible secondary link, add hidden SR text and update color to #D9534F. pushing a tiny PR to the style token branch in a bit — will drop the PR link here. :thumbsup: Tom: cool, let's run this in canary for a week and check support hits. Maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/1234 — includes copy tokens + aria-live example. please review. copybot: quick emoji reaction :sparkles: Maya: thanks all!
